heading: INT. CASINO BASEMENT - COUNTING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CASINO BASEMENT - COUNTING ROOM - NIGHT
A windowless vault of stainless steel counters and humming money counters.
Stacks of bills in rubber bands.
A camera dome on the ceiling blinks green.
NOVA, 30s, in a black security uniform with a mismatched badge, pushes a cart of laundry through the door.
Her gait is bored and easy.
She parks the cart, picks up a clipboard, and begins to count towels.
At the far counter, FELIX, 50s, the night supervisor, sits in a swivel chair eating a sandwich.
He glances at her once, then returns to his sandwich.
She does not look at him.
She walks the length of the room, adjusts a stack of towels, nudges a bill-counter's cover straight, checks the clipboard.
She is just a woman doing a dull job.
You're new.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Third week.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: They don't send laundry down this late.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: They do when the fountain overflows.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: He considers this.
Swivels, chews.
She keeps counting.
Which one of the fountains?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Lobby. The big one.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: The big one doesn't overflow.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Tell that to the lobby.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: Felix puts down the sandwich.
He wipes his fingers on a napkin, one at a time.
His hand drifts toward a desk phone and stops.
She notices, and for an instant her bored mask slips and slides back.
She walks to the cart, reaches under the towels, and withdraws not a towel but a short black cylinder.
She turns, thumb on a pin, smiling at him as one smiles at a toddler.
Felix. Don't.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: How do you know my name?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: It's on your lanyard.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: His eyes drop to the lanyard.
They come up again.
He lifts both hands slowly from the desk, and Nova steps closer, the cylinder held low, almost gently, as the camera dome on the ceiling blinks from green to red.
That camera...
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I know. I've been waiting for it.
units.name: NOVA

units.text: She tosses the cylinder underhand onto his desk.
It rolls to a stop against the sandwich, and Felix flinches.
Nothing happens.
It is only a flashlight.
Nova laughs, quietly, and wheels the cart toward the vault door, which clicks open from the other side.
